about:
Northeast Fabricators & Mechanical Services operates from a 32,000-square-foot facility in Dalton, Massachusetts, at Ashuelot Park. The company was formed in February 2001 and has grown from a two-person operation to a team of 19 skilled craftsmen, including welders, pipers, millwrights, and mechanics.

The shop provides full-service welding and metal fabrication, offering in-house production and on-site field support. Capabilities span high-definition CNC plasma cutting, structural welding (MIG, TIG, stick, soldering, brazing), metal forming, piping, shearing, sawing, drilling, tapping, pipe bending, and heavy equipment rebuilds. The team works with steel, stainless steel, mild steel, aluminum, and various tubing profiles, using CAD/CAM design support to turn prints into finished parts such as custom tanks, armor plates, water filtration equipment, pump skids, and chemical dosing systems.

Customers include paper mills, construction firms, industrial and commercial clients across Western Massachusetts, and defense-sector buyers requiring armor plates, gas tanks, and other specialty fabrications. The company also builds commercial snow plow frames, trailer rebuilds, retail display racks, and custom signage.

Leadership emphasizes craftsmanship, innovative solutions, reliability, and responsiveness as the foundation of its reputation. The mission centers on maintaining state-of-the-art equipment, fostering teamwork, and investing in tools that enable the highest quality work, with a stated goal of 100 percent customer satisfaction.
